name: Zachariah
bio:
Zachariah succeeded his father Jeroboam as king of Israel after Jeroboam's forty-one-year reign ended (2 Kings 14:29).

## 📖 Core Story: A Six-Month Reign, and a Fulfilled Prophecy

Zachariah reigned over Israel in Samaria for only six months, doing evil in the LORD's eyes like his fathers before him. Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him, struck him down in front of the people, and killed him, taking the throne for himself — fulfilling the LORD's old word to Jehu that his descendants would sit on Israel's throne for four generations, no further (2 Kings 15:8-12).
